<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 20pt">Press Release</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>S&amp;P Global Provides Pro Forma and Recast
Financial Results and Updated Segment Information</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">New reported business lines for Energy and Market
Intelligence</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">Updated allocated expenses and margins for the
enterprise and all four divisions</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">2026 guidance reflecting the spin-off of Mobility
to be provided with 2Q 2026 Earnings on July&nbsp;28</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">New York, NY, July 6, 2026 &ndash; S&amp;P Global
(NYSE: SPGI) is providing recast financial results, excluding the contribution from the Mobility division (&ldquo;Mobility&rdquo;). In
a previous release dated July 1, 2026, the Company announced the successful completion of the spin of Mobility into an independent, public
company &ndash; Mobility Global (NYSE: MBGL).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The Company expects to report 2Q 2026 results
on July&nbsp;28, 2026, </B>at which time the Company will report GAAP financial results that will include Mobility for the full second
quarter. Beginning with the third quarter of 2026, the Company&rsquo;s financial results will not include financial results from Mobility
on either a GAAP or adjusted basis. The Company expects to introduce 2026 GAAP guidance and update 2026 adjusted guidance reflecting the
exclusion of Mobility in conjunction with the release of 2Q 2026 results. Details on how to access earnings materials are provided near
the end of this release.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Pro Forma and Recast Financial Results</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company is providing pro forma quarterly segment
financial information for the full year 2025, the four quarters of 2025, and the first quarter of 2026, to reflect the Mobility spin-off.
Financials provided below also reflect a company recast including inter-segment adjustments and changes to expense allocation methodologies
as outlined below. The financial information by division is provided below and is accessible on the Company&rsquo;s Investor Relations
website under the section titled &ldquo;SEC Filings&nbsp;&amp; Reports&rdquo; as well as the section titled &ldquo;Quarterly Earnings&nbsp;&amp;
Monthly Metrics&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>S&amp;P Global Updated Division Structure</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">With the completion of the Mobility spin, S&amp;P
Global now operates with four reportable segments. Metrics below represent full-year 2025 recast segment revenue as a percentage of S&amp;P
Global pro forma revenue (excluding inter-segment elimination), and full-year 2025 pro forma non-GAAP adjusted segment operating profit
and margin metrics, as reconciled in the tables at the end of this release. Note: percentages presented below may not sum to 100% due to
rounding.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>Impacts to S&amp;P Global Ratings</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">There are no changes to the revenue disclosures
for S&amp;P Global Ratings. The S&amp;P Global Ratings division will continue to be presented with five externally reported business lines
 &ndash; Corporates (53% of 2025 division revenue), Financials (16%), Structured Finance (13%), Governments (7%), and Crisil/Other (12%).
Revenue will continue to be reported under transaction revenue and non-transaction revenue.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>Impacts to S&amp;P Dow Jones Indices</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">There are no changes to the revenue disclosures
for the S&amp;P Dow Jones Indices division. The division will continue to be presented with three externally reported business lines &ndash;
Asset-Linked Fees (65% of 2025 division revenue), Exchange-Traded Derivatives (18%), and Data&nbsp;&amp; Custom Subscriptions (17%).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>Impacts to S&amp;P Global Energy</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Energy division will be presented with two externally reported
business lines &ndash; Platts (49% of 2025 recast division revenue), and CERA (51%).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Platts:</B> This business line includes the
benchmark products sold through the Energy division, including Platts benchmark prices, Forward Curves, Global Trading Services, and related
news and reports.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The business objective of Platts is continued
growth and margin expansion by extending global leadership in commodity benchmark prices and associated products.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>CERA</B>: This business line includes the proprietary
data, research, and content previously reported under Energy&nbsp;&amp; Resources Data&nbsp;&amp; Insights, Upstream Data&nbsp;&amp; Insights,
as well as global marquee conferences such as CERAWeek. The CERA business line also includes 451 Research and Maritime&nbsp;&amp; Trade
products that were previously included in Market Intelligence.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The business objective of CERA is to improve revenue
growth and margin expansion through the generation and distribution of differentiated, proprietary data and content related to the commodities
markets and global supply chain. This includes content informed in part by Platts benchmark prices and processes, as well as the new,
AI-native upstream data solution, CERA Titan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>The table below illustrates recast Energy
revenue by business line and by type.</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&nbsp;</FONT></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><U>Impacts to S&amp;P Global Market Intelligence</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Market Intelligence (MI) division will be
presented with two externally reported business lines &ndash; Kensho Data &amp; Platforms (60% of 2025 recast division revenue), and Enterprise
Solutions (40%).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Kensho Data&nbsp;&amp; Platforms</B>: This
business line will include products previously reported under Data, Analytics,&nbsp;&amp; Insights with the following exceptions: 451
Research and Maritime&nbsp;&amp; Trade (both moving to S&amp;P Global Energy), and pricing and reference data (now in MI: Enterprise Solutions).
This business line will also include products previously reported under Credit&nbsp;&amp; Risk Solutions, other than Financial Risk Analytics
(now in MI: Enterprise Solutions).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><U>Key product groups reported in this business
line will include (not exhaustive):</U></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Kensho Data: Market Intelligence data products, including Compustat, Financials&nbsp;&amp; Estimates,
Kensho LLM-Ready APIs, RatingsXpress, and SNL</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Platforms: Capital IQ, Consulting,&nbsp;Issuer Solutions, RatingsDirect, Visible Alpha, and With Intelligence</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The business objective for Kensho Data is to accelerate
data revenue growth and improve profitability, serving as the data and AI-delivery layer for Market Intelligence, expanding distribution
channels, and extending the client base. The business objective of Platforms is to improve revenue growth and profitability through the
consolidation of existing client interfaces and enabling new user interfaces like MCP-connected solutions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Enterprise Solutions</B>: This business line
will include all products previously reported under Enterprise Solutions, as well as Financial Risk Analytics (previously reported in
Credit&nbsp;&amp; Risk Solutions), pricing and reference data, and Valuation Services (previously in Data, Analytics&nbsp;&amp; Insights).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><U>Key product groups reported in this business
line will include (not exhaustive):</U></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Lending Solutions: ClearPar, Debtdomain, pricing and reference data, Notice Manager, and Wall Street Office
(WSO)</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Market Solutions: iLEVEL, Primary Markets Group (Equity&nbsp;&amp; Debt Bookbuilding), and Valuation Services</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Software and Regulatory Solutions: Cappitech, Corporate Actions, Counterparty Manager, Financial Risk
Analytics, and Tax Solutions</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The business objective of Enterprise Solutions
is to drive revenue growth and margin expansion by delivering highly differentiated solutions that power critical infrastructure, networks,
and workflows tied to financial markets, with a focus on the most differentiated software assets. Pricing and reference data is leveraged
by, and generates meaningful customer value throughout, the Enterprise Solutions business line.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><U>Impacts to Expenses and Division Operating Profit Margins</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Expenses and Division operating profit margins
will be impacted by the following three factors:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Product transfers</B>: The transfer of products between the Market Intelligence and Energy divisions
will include the transfer of both revenue and expenses. Additionally, a small portion of expenses associated with Credit Analytics products
will be transferred from Market Intelligence to Ratings. As a result, expenses, operating profit, and operating margin of these three
divisions will be impacted.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Improved allocation methodology for shared enterprise expenses</B>: Allocations in recast financials,
as well as future reporting periods, reflect enhancements made to the allocation methodology of enterprise expenses. These changes are
being made to ensure that expenses associated with certain corporate functions and shared services, including technology, are allocated
based on consumption. Prior methodology allocated expenses based on broader methodologies such as percent of revenue or percent of employee
headcount.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Stranded Mobility costs:</B> While the net impact of stranded costs to enterprise margins is largely
immaterial, there are offsets through the Transition Services Agreement (TSA) with Mobility Global that will be recognized at the corporate
level. Stranded costs will be allocated at the division level, with the offsetting income from the TSA recognized as a contra-expense
that is expected to lower corporate unallocated expenses.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Comparison of Adjusted Information to U.S.
GAAP Information: </B> The Company reports its financial results in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United
States (&quot;GAAP&quot;). Company financial results are also presented on an as-reported basis, and on a pro forma basis as if the Mobility
spin-off had closed on January&nbsp;1, 2023, for periods including fiscal years 2023, 2024 and 2025, and the three months ended March&nbsp;31,
2026; the pro forma basis agrees to the Company&rsquo;s unaudited pro forma combined consolidated financial information presented in accordance
with Article&nbsp;11 of Regulation S-X. The Company also refers to and presents certain additional non-GAAP financial measures, within
the meaning of Regulation G under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. These measures are: pro forma non-GAAP adjusted net income from
continuing operations; pro forma non-GAAP adjusted diluted earnings per share from continuing operations; adjusted operating profit and
margin; pro forma non-GAAP adjusted operating profit and margin; pro forma non-GAAP adjusted segment operating profit and margin; adjusted
expenses; adjusted corporate unallocated expense; and adjusted equity in income on unconsolidated subsidiaries.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company has included reconciliations of these
non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP in the tables below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company's non-GAAP measures include adjustments
that reflect how management views our businesses. The Company believes these non-GAAP financial measures provide useful supplemental information
that enables investors to better compare the Company's performance across periods, and management also uses these measures internally
to assess the operating performance of its business, to assess performance for employee compensation purposes and to decide how to allocate
resources. However, investors should not consider any of these non-GAAP measures in isolation from, or as a substitute for, the financial
information that the Company reports.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

which express management&rsquo;s current views concerning future events, trends, contingencies or results, appear at various places in
this report and use words like &ldquo;anticipate,&rdquo; &ldquo;assume,&rdquo; &ldquo;believe,&rdquo; &ldquo;continue,&rdquo; &ldquo;estimate,&rdquo;

tense verbs like &ldquo;could,&rdquo; &ldquo;may,&rdquo; &ldquo;might,&rdquo; &ldquo;should,&rdquo; &ldquo;will&rdquo; and &ldquo;would.&rdquo;
For example, management may use forward-looking statements when addressing topics such as: the outcome of contingencies; future actions
by regulators; changes in the Company&rsquo;s business strategies and methods of generating revenue; the development and performance of
the Company&rsquo;s services and products; the expected impact of acquisitions and dispositions; the Company&rsquo;s effective tax rates;
and the Company&rsquo;s cost structure, dividend policy, cash flows or liquidity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>About S&amp;P Global</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">S&amp;P Global (NYSE: SPGI) enables businesses,
governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential
Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and
thrive in a rapidly changing global landscape.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">From helping our customers assess new investments
across the capital and commodities markets to navigating the energy expansion, acceleration of artificial intelligence, and evolution
of public and private markets, we enable the world's leading organizations to unlock opportunities, solve challenges, and plan for tomorrow
 &ndash; today. Learn more at www.spglobal.com.</P>
